tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page behind everything (`--bg` in src/theme/tokens.js). Show: blue-700; Daylight: gray-100; Contrast: blue-900.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, menus: anything that sits on bg (`--panel`). The pattern tone #03213a in Show.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, phone tab bar and the browser theme-color (`--chrome`). Darkest ground in the dark themes.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Input wells and the tint under inline previews (`--shade`, used at 40% in ui.jsx input).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Base colour every line, fill and hover is mixed from (`--fg`). Never used as a surface itself.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and titles on bg, panel and chrome (`--text`).

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: Secondary text that still has to read at a glance: venue, client, call times (`--text2`).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, helper copy, inactive nav (`--muted`). 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels (`--soft`). Same value as muted until a theme needs them apart.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action per view: primary button fill, active tab bar, selected switch (`--accent`). Lime in Show and Contrast, navy in Daylight. Never a background for areas, never a gradient.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent (`--accent2`). No gradients between accent and accent2.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or a live indicator on bg/panel: links, active labels, the AVX glyph in the UI, 'confirmed' squares (`--accent-text`). Olive in Daylight because lime fails on white.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (`--on-accent`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards: fg at 7% × lineK (ui.jsx colors.border).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls (buttons, inputs, checkboxes, segmented) and the hover edge of cards: fg at 38% × lineK, the lowest mix that is 3:1 on panel in every theme. Replaces the 28%/9% mixes in ui.jsx.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Card fill on top of panel/bg: fg at 3% × lineK (ui.jsx card).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row and nav hover, pressed ghost buttons: fg at 6% × lineK.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1 on bg and panel.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected table row, picked list item: accent at 12% over panel, with a 2px accent bar.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and sheets. Flat 72% black: no blur (backdrop-filter is not part of the language).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, clashes, lost/written-off, destructive buttons' edge and text (`--danger`). Text-safe on every ground.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner or a clash row: danger at 16% over panel. Text on it stays text/danger.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Holds, shortages, inspections due, unsaved/offline (`--warn`). Text-safe on every ground.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning banner: warn at 14% over panel.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, the 'blue' gig label, links inside help (`--info`).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Gig label 'sky' only (`--sky`).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Gig label 'purple' only (`--purple`).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Gig label 'pink' only (`--pink`).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Gig label 'yellow' only (`--yellow`).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Gig label 'orange' only (`--orange`).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Call sheet, quote document, packing list, QR labels: printed paper is always white whatever the theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper: blue-700.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title on a computer, one per page (PageHeader).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title on a phone (below 768px), one per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heading (Section), card and dialog titles. A section has a heading or an 11px eyebrow, never both.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Load-in at the loading dock, stage left. Bring your own gloves.
styles.usage: Sentences, names in lists, buttons, inputs (inputs 16px on a phone).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, sentence case (body size, weight 600).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata under a name, hints, table cells. 12px is not used: it goes to 13.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: field labels, table heads, status words. One level only; nothing smaller than 11px.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Times, dates, money, durations, codes, addresses in rows and tables.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: A big number: key numbers, totals, a call time.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Timecode and clocks in field tools only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Within an item: icon to label, a name to its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Within an item: inline gaps in rows and toolbars; the compact gap in data grids.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items: list items, fields in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between items; card padding; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; padding of big cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: From the page header to the first section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on a computer (space-section).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between sections: 40px on a phone, 48px from 768px (`--space-section`). At least three times the gap inside a section, so grouping reads without a border.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter: 16px on a phone, 24px from 768px (`--gutter`). Content column 960px max.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner in AVX, enforced globally in index.html. There is no other radius.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls inside data grids only (quote line inline actions).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Touch: phone forms, scan panel, availability answers. Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: List row with a name and a meta line; a hairline between rows, no card per row.

tokens.name: row-single
tokens.usage: List row with one line; nav items.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Data grids only: quote lines, dense tables, patch and input lists (the only compact places).

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Desktop top bar height.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Phone bottom bar height, plus the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: Mega-menu panel width on desktop.
